title: Semantically Rich, Metrically Affect-Blind: A Geometric Blind Spot in Modern Text Embedders
abstract: arXiv:2610.32122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report a systematic dissociation in modern text embedders: sentiment is almost perfectly decodable from their embeddings, yet almost entirely absent from their metric. Across eleven frozen encoders spanning 2021 to 2026, including 2026-generation models and the 4B-parameter LLM embedder Qwen3-Embedding-4B, a linear probe recovers sentence polarity at up to 91.3% accuracy while cosine similarity separates polarity by a margin of only 0.003-0.064. Qwen3-Embedding-4B, the strongest probe in the panel, reaches 91.3% probe accuracy but only 64.3 retrieval MAP. Because retrieval, clustering, deduplication, and retrieval-augmented generation operate on the metric rather than on a trained probe, these systems are effectively blind to information their encoder demonstrably contains. A task-conditioning control suggests this reflects the pretraining objective rather than a prompting artifact: conditioning Jina-v5 on its classification task rath

translated_title: 语义丰富，度量情感盲区：现代文本嵌入器中的几何盲点
translated_abstract: 我们报告了现代文本嵌入器中的一种系统性分离现象：情感几乎可以完美地从其嵌入中解码出来，却几乎完全缺失于其度量之中。在涵盖2021至2026年的十一个冻结编码器上，包括2026年世代的模型以及40亿参数的LLM嵌入器Qwen3-Embedding-4B，线性探针能以高达91.3%的准确率恢复句子极性，而余弦相似度区分极性的差距仅为0.003至0.064。Qwen3-Embedding-4B是该组中探针性能最强的模型，其探针准确率达到91.3%，但检索MAP仅为64.3。由于检索、聚类、去重和检索增强生成（RAG）都是基于度量而非训练好的探针来运行的，这些系统对其编码器确实包含的信息实际上是“视而不见”的。一项任务条件控制实验表明，这反映的是预训练目标本身，而非提示方式的伪影：将Jina-v5以其分类任务为条件进行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 现代文本嵌入器的嵌入向量中几乎可以完美解码情感信息（线性探针准确率高达91.3%），但其度量空间（余弦相似度）几乎完全无法区分情感，导致依赖度量的检索、聚类、去重和RAG系统对这类信息“视而不见”。
en_tdlr: Modern text embedders contain nearly perfectly decodable sentiment information in their embeddings (up to 91.3% linear probe accuracy), yet their metric (cosine similarity) is almost entirely blind to it, rendering metric-based systems like retrieval, clustering, deduplication, and RAG effectively unable to exploit this information.
